QuestInfo.name: Magatia's Dark Alchemy
QuestInfo.0: #p2151009# told you of Dark Alchemy, hidden in the town of #m261000000#. This Dark Alchemy could be connected with the Black Mage...
QuestInfo.1: #b#m261000000#'s#k Alchemy was developed by 2 associations, the Zenumists and the Alcadno. Visit #b#p2159319##k, the president of #bZenumist#k Association, and ask him about Dark Alchemy.
QuestInfo.2: The rumor about #m261000000#'s Dark Alchemy was true! However, Carson told you that their half of the #t04032975# was stolen. Go to the Alcadno Association and see if the other half is safe.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 112,999
Can proceed to Forbidden Book of Alchemy

0.0: I've got a lead, #h0#. This place called #m261000000# is the capital of alchemy, and apparently, they've hidden a book of Dark Alchemy there.
0.1: When I visited #m261000000# a long time ago, I heard a rumor about their hidden alchemy. Supposedly, they have some techniques that draw on darkness itself. I'm pretty sure we should look into that.

yes.0: Alchemy is developed and divided between two associations, Zenumist and Alcadno, in #b#m261000000##k. You should start with the #bZenumist#k President, #b#p2159319##k, and see what he knows about Dark Alchemy.

no.0: There's definitely something off about the alchemy in #m261000000#. If you're too busy raging out on other things, I suppose it can wait..we can always investigate the place later.

1.0: Buh, wha... What just happened?\r\n#L0##bAre you the Zenumist President, #p2159319#?#l\n#k
1.1: Huh? Who are you? I don't have time to blabber with you!\r\n#L0##bWe need to talk about Dark Alchemy.#l\n#k
1.2: W-what? Dark Alchemy? Who...who told you about that? Who are you?\r\n#L0##bI seek dark artifacts of the Black Mage, and destroy them. I'm here because I know you have some relic of Dark Alchemy.#l\n#k
1.3: Well, you seem to know all about it, but you're too late. Someone just stole our Forbidden Book of Alchemy.

yes.0: You're different from the ones who stole the Forbidden Book of Alchemy. Why is everyone looking for it now? Has #p2159320# been telling people about it?

npc.0: #b#p2159319##k is the president of the Zenumists in #b#m261000000##k.
